summary: JunVideo MVP is implemented and verified end to end. Core acceptance criteria pass. Anonymous parsing is confirmed for the tested Bilibili public page; Douyin and Xiaohongshu remain dependent on current platform session/anti-bot conditions and return actionable errors rather than bypassing access controls.

evidence: TypeScript API compile and Vite production bundle completed
npm.cmd run db:init applied database/schema.sql to localhost:5432/junvideo
backend-smoke registered an account, rejected wrong password, and logged in with JWT
mock API smoke accepted 10 normal parses, rejected the 11th with 429, and accepted a VIP parse after /api/dev/vip/activate
server/src/platform.test.ts passed priority detection, Chinese share-text/Markdown URL extraction, and URL safety
preflight recognized Douyin, Xiaohongshu, and Bilibili
Bilibili https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV16SduBKE9z/ returned HTTP 201, duration 259s, 12 video formats and 3 audio formats
The selected Bilibili stream returned HTTP 200 through /api/proxy with video/mp4, Content-Length 73127080 and attachment disposition
Bilibili https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1V1GF6dE3z/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=45844627e3657d8e84d2d62d0b62f139 completed a 220481131-byte proxied stream after the media connection-timeout fix

The exact user-supplied Chinese Bilibili description plus link returned HTTP 201 with a normalized source URL; the exact Chinese Xiaohongshu share text returned a platform-specific no-video-stream error rather than INVALID_INPUT
A complete lower-quality Bilibili video/audio/cover stream read matched declared Content-Length values; transient CDN statuses now have limited proxy retries
Douyin https://www.douyin.com/video/7607423497794620712 returned an actionable fresh-authorized-session error
Xiaohongshu https://www.xiaohongshu.com/explore/6a06c9360000000036001d5a returned an actionable public-video-note/session error

Three-round priority smoke passed the two-phase contract: Bilibili metadata-only parse in phase one, then video/audio/cover proxy probes returned 200 in phase two for all three rounds; the supplied Douyin/Xiaohongshu links returned stable actionable platform-condition errors
local browser verification covered API status after reload, Chinese share text normalization, Bilibili two-phase format options, and authenticated cover download action
README and UI state support public authorized content only and explicitly reject DRM, login-wall, paywall and permanent-cache bypass

knownLimitations: Production billing/webhook is not implemented; development VIP activation is intentionally disabled in production.
Video and audio streams are offered separately; server-side ffmpeg muxing is a future extension.
The supplied Douyin short link still requires an authorized fresh browser session under current yt-dlp/platform behavior; the supplied Xiaohongshu note currently returns no video stream.
Some platforms require an authorized session. Configure exactly one of YTDLP_COOKIES_FILE or YTDLP_COOKIES_FROM_BROWSER and never commit credentials.
recommendation: Ready for local MVP handoff; before production, add billing, rate limiting, observability, encrypted secret management, and a platform-specific regression corpus.
